text: I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; And I am saved from my enemies.
In my distress [when I seemed surrounded] I called upon the LORD And cried to my God for help; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry for help came before Him, into His very ears.
Then the stream beds of the waters appeared, And the foundations of the world were laid bare At Your rebuke, O LORD, At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
He brought me out into a broad place; He rescued me because He was pleased with me and delighted in me.
Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness (moral character, spiritual integrity), According to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
For by You I can crush a troop, And by my God I can leap over a wall.
You enlarge the path beneath me and make my steps secure, So that my feet will not slip.
Then I beat them fine as the dust before the wind; I emptied them out as the dirt of the streets.
Foreigners lose heart, And come trembling out of their strongholds.
He gives great triumphs to His king, And shows steadfast love and mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forever.
